That is defaults.

We also need to double check that outer panels, inner blocks and buttons and other bordered elements have the same each side border configuration we have for outer panels.

Also not all border configurations correctly slice content inside the block if it does not fit, and not all of configuration correctly handle transparent background, selection and so on. That is visible on settings page, so we should have more configuration.

It is also important to have more configuration for width of highlight on top, more configuration about width of borders on corners and on sides separately.

Also it should be possible to configure layout of border corners (by default on top), but they should cover highlights on the left side for positions and so on.

Double check also where we can add more configuration and also make this preset even more perfect to eye.

Meaning we should catch glitches and fix them, which are not properly handled, for that we should be able to render small samples of each UI/UX elements and so on.

For color configuration we should have ability to select palettes of colors, not only use sliders to select colors, for user to select best neon and pastel colors and so on.

So it fast and easy to use.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
